Enum Class NozzleFlowMeter.NozzleType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<NozzleFlowMeter.NozzleType>
neqsim.process.measurementdevice.NozzleFlowMeter.NozzleType

public static enum NozzleFlowMeter.NozzleType extends Enum<NozzleFlowMeter.NozzleType>
The four nozzle sub-types of ISO 5167-3, each with its own discharge-coefficient formula and limits of use.

  • Enum Constant Summary

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    ISA_1932
    ISA 1932 nozzle, ISO 5167-3 5.1: 50 mm <= D <= 500 mm, 0.3 <= beta <= 0.8, Re,D >= 7.0e4 (beta < 0.44) or 2.0e4 (beta >= 0.44), Re,D <= 1.0e7.
    LONG_RADIUS
    Long radius nozzle, ISO 5167-3 5.2: 50 mm <= D <= 630 mm, 0.2 <= beta <= 0.8, 1.0e4 <= Re,D <= 1.0e7.
    THROAT_TAPPED
    Throat-tapped flow nozzle, ISO 5167-3 5.3: 100 mm <= D <= 630 mm, 0.4 <= beta <= 0.5, 8.0e5 <= Re,d <= 2.0e7.
    VENTURI_NOZZLE
    Venturi nozzle, ISO 5167-3 5.4: 65 mm <= D <= 500 mm, d >= 50 mm, 0.316 <= beta <= 0.775, 1.5e5 <= Re,D <= 2.0e6.
